title: FRMD8 inhibits tumor metastasis in BRCA1-associated TNBC by negatively regulating tmTNF-alpha.
authors: Xu, Jun; Yang, Xiaoyu; Shu, Peng; Wang, Wei; Wu, Haibo; Wang, Zhe
one_liner_zh: 该文研究FRMD8调控tmTNF-alpha裂解影响三阴性乳腺癌转移，属纯湿实验肿瘤生物学，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), particularly in patients with metastasis, is associated with limited treatment options and shorter survival times. In this study, through library screening and animal experiments, we identified that the low expression of FERM domain-containing protein 8 (FRMD8) in breast cancer type 1 susceptibility protein (BRCA1)-mutant breast cancer cells (TNBC subtype), significantly enhances the metastatic potential of tumor cells to various organs. Further functional experiments revealed that FRMD8(low) inhibited the cleavage of tmTNF-alpha (transmembrane TNF-alpha) and promoted the expression of surface tmTNF-alpha. We also identified that the mechanism by which FRMD8 regulates tmTNF-alpha is related to the inhibition of inactive rhomboid protein 2 (iRHOM2) degradation, which acts mainly through the endocytic pathway. Furthermore, FRMD8(low)/iRHOM2(low) greatly facilitated the in vivo metastasis of TNBC. Finally, we found that combined treatment with paclitaxel and etanercept reversed the expression of FRMD8 and iRHOM2, concomitantly inhibiting the metastatic potential in vivo. This study explores how FRMD8 influences TNF-alpha processing and the metastatic behavior of breast cancer, providing insights into molecular dynamics that could guide future therapeutic strategies to improve outcomes in patients with breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC），尤其是伴有转移的患者，治疗选择有限且生存时间较短。在本研究中，通过文库筛选和动物实验，我们发现在乳腺癌1型易感蛋白（BRCA1）突变乳腺癌细胞（TNBC亚型）中，FERM结构域蛋白8（FRMD8）的低表达显著增强了肿瘤细胞向多器官的转移潜力。进一步的功能实验揭示，FRMD8(low)抑制了跨膜TNF-α（tmTNF-alpha）的切割，并促进了表面tmTNF-alpha的表达。我们还发现，FRMD8调控tmTNF-alpha的机制与抑制非活性菱形蛋白2（iRHOM2）的降解有关，该过程主要通过内吞途径发挥作用。此外，FRMD8(low)/iRHOM2(low)极大地促进了TNBC的体内转移。最后，我们发现紫杉醇和依那西普的联合治疗逆转了FRMD8和iRHOM2的表达，同时抑制了体内转移潜力。本研究探讨了FRMD8如何影响TNF-alpha的加工及乳腺癌的转移行为，为分子动力学提供了见解，这可能指导未来治疗策略以改善乳腺癌患者的预后。
